title: CWE-20 - Improper Input Validation
content: The product receives input but does not validate, or incorrectly validates, properties required for safe processing.

title: CWE-22 - Path Traversal
content: Improper limitation of pathnames to a restricted directory can let an attacker access files outside the intended location.

title: CWE-78 - OS Command Injection
content: Improper neutralization of special elements in operating-system commands can allow attacker-controlled command execution.

title: CWE-79 - Cross-site Scripting
content: Improper neutralization of input during web-page generation can cause attacker-controlled script execution in a browser.

title: CWE-89 - SQL Injection
content: Improper neutralization of special elements in SQL commands can alter the intended database query.

title: CWE-287 - Improper Authentication
content: The product does not sufficiently prove that a claimed identity is correct.

title: CWE-306 - Missing Authentication for Critical Function
content: A critical function is exposed without requiring authentication.

title: CWE-352 - Cross-Site Request Forgery
content: A web application does not adequately verify that a state-changing request was intentionally sent by the authenticated user.

title: CWE-434 - Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type
content: Insufficient validation of uploaded file types can allow dangerous content to be processed or executed.

title: CWE-502 - Deserialization of Untrusted Data
content: Deserializing attacker-controlled data without sufficient verification can alter application logic or trigger code execution.

title: CWE-787 - Out-of-bounds Write
content: Writing data beyond the intended memory buffer can corrupt memory and may enable code execution.

title: CWE-798 - Hard-coded Credentials
content: Credentials embedded directly in software can be recovered and reused by unauthorized parties.

title: CWE-862 - Missing Authorization
content: The product does not perform an authorization check when a user attempts to access a resource or action.

title: CWE-918 - Server-Side Request Forgery
content: A server fetches a remote resource using attacker-influenced input without adequately validating the destination.

title: CWE-400 - Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
content: The product does not adequately control allocation or use of a limited resource, which can reduce availability.

title: CAPEC-66 - SQL Injection
content: An attacker injects SQL syntax through an application input to alter database commands and their execution.

title: CAPEC-88 - OS Command Injection
content: An attacker supplies command syntax that a vulnerable application passes to an operating-system command processor.

title: CAPEC-100 - Overflow Buffers
content: An attacker provides more data than a buffer can hold to corrupt adjacent memory and affect execution.

title: CAPEC-115 - Authentication Bypass
content: An attacker exploits weaknesses in an authentication mechanism to access protected functionality without valid proof of identity.

title: CAPEC-126 - Path Traversal
content: An attacker manipulates path input to access files and directories outside the intended application boundary.
